scripts.install:all: concurrently "yarn install" "yarn --cwd api-gateway install" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service install" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service install" "yarn --cwd frontend/institute_protal install" "yarn --cwd frontend/sass_protal install" "(cd backend/flask_derver && python3 -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt)" "(cd backend/ai_core && uv sync)"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "api,institute,saas,flask,ai_core,inst_portal,sass_portal" -c "cyan,green,magenta,yellow,white,blue,red" "yarn --cwd api-gateway run start:dev" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service run start:dev" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service run start:dev" "(cd backend/flask_derver && . venv/bin/activate && python3 app.py)" "(cd backend/ai_core && uv run python main.py)" "yarn --cwd frontend/institute_protal run dev" "yarn --cwd frontend/sass_protal run dev"
scripts.start:backend: concurrently -k -n "api,institute,saas,flask,ai_core" -c "cyan,green,magenta,yellow,white" "yarn --cwd api-gateway run start:dev" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service run start:dev" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service run start:dev" "(cd backend/flask_derver && . venv/bin/activate && python3 app.py)" "(cd backend/ai_core && uv run python main.py)"
scripts.start:frontend: concurrently -k -n "inst_portal,sass_portal" -c "blue,red" "yarn --cwd frontend/institute_protal run dev" "yarn --cwd frontend/sass_protal run dev"
scripts.build:all: concurrently "yarn --cwd api-gateway run build" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service run build" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service run build" "yarn --cwd frontend/institute_protal run build" "yarn --cwd frontend/sass_protal run build"
scripts.test: concurrently "yarn --cwd api-gateway test" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service test" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service test"
scripts.lint: concurrently "yarn --cwd api-gateway run lint" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service run lint" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service run lint" "yarn --cwd frontend/institute_protal run lint" "yarn --cwd frontend/sass_protal run lint"
